commande.description: Machines into one or more panels (the targets) the rabbet or groove where a panel (the insert) fits, with a clearance. If the insert already enters a target, it keeps its place; if it only touches it, it is lengthened by the depth. One timeline line that follows the furniture.
commande.jeu_infobulle: Added on each side and at the bottom of the cut, for a fit without forcing.
commande.profondeur_infobulle: For a target the insert only touches: the insert is lengthened to enter it by this depth. A target the insert already enters keeps that overlap.
commande.invite: Select the insert, then the targets.
commande.echec: Rabbet / groove failed: {detail}. Details in journal.log.
commande.double_clic: Double-click a Rabbet / groove line in the timeline.
edition.description: Reopens the dialog of a rabbet / groove (double-click in the timeline).
erreur.historique: The design must capture design history (timeline).
erreur.jeu_negatif: the clearance must be zero or more
erreur.pas_de_contact: the insert does not touch it
erreur.entree_perdue: entry direction lost, edit the operation
erreur.plus_de_chevauchement: the insert no longer enters it
erreur.armature_dans_la_cible: the insert is entirely inside it
erreur.profondeur_nulle: the depth must be greater than 0
erreur.profondeur_trop_grande: depth equal to or greater than its thickness ({profondeur} mm)
erreur.plusieurs_corps: "{nom}" contains several bodies: select the body.
erreur.cible_partagee: The target "{nom}" is used {n} times in the design: the cut would appear in every copy. Use "Paste New" to make it unique.
erreur.armature_partagee: "{nom}" is used {n} times in the design: lengthening it would lengthen every copy. Use "Paste New" to make it unique.
erreur.composant_lie: "{composant}" comes from another design (linked component): it cannot be modified here.
erreur.rien_a_faire: No usable target: see the lines above.
erreur.ouverture: The dialog could not open ({detail}). Details in journal.log.
erreur.piece_disparue: A part of the operation has disappeared.
erreur.recul_refuse: Fusion refuses to roll the timeline back before "{fonction}".
etape.fin_timeline: moving the timeline marker to the end
commande.armature_infobulle: The panel that enters the targets (body or component). It is never deleted.
commande.cibles_infobulle: The panels that receive the rabbet or groove (bodies or components).
commande.ancienne_version: Operation from version 0.1 (one target, several inserts): delete it and make it again.
